title: Why AI Can't Count the R's in Strawberry

lines.tts: Ask ChatGPT how many R's are in strawberry, and for ages it said two.
lines.text: Ask ChatGPT how many R's are in strawberry, and for ages it said two.

lines.tts: It can write you a poem, but it can't count letters? Here's why.
lines.text: It can write you a poem, but it can't count letters? Here's why.

lines.tts: AI never sees letters. Before it reads a single word, your sentence gets chopped into chunks called tokens.
lines.text: AI never sees letters. Before it reads a single word, your sentence gets chopped into chunks called tokens.

lines.tts: Strawberry becomes something like... strr... aww... berry. Three chunks, and each one gets swapped for a number.
lines.text: Strawberry becomes something like str, aw, berry. Three chunks, and each one gets swapped for a number.

lines.tts: You see, it's like ordering from a menu where every dish is a number. You know number seven is pizza, but you couldn't tell me how many olives are on it.
lines.text: You see, it's like ordering from a menu where every dish is a number. You know number seven is pizza, but you couldn't tell me how many olives are on it.

lines.tts: So when you ask about letters, it isn't counting. It's guessing from memory.
lines.text: So when you ask about letters, it isn't counting. It's guessing from memory.

lines.tts: That's why newer models spell the word out first, letter by letter, and then count.
lines.text: That's why newer models spell the word out first, letter by letter, and then count.

lines.tts: The smartest machine on the planet, beaten by a damn fruit.
lines.text: The smartest machine on the planet, beaten by a damn fruit.
